name: Chart transfer — paper copy
note: Includes the first 15 minutes of review. Additional review needs advance agreement.

name: Chart transfer — secure electronic
note: For transfer without associated delivery costs; additional review is calculated separately.

name: Brief sick / return-to-work / school note
note: Brief confirmation only.

name: Certificate of freedom from communicable disease
note: Certificate only; an insured assessment is not an additional patient charge.

name: School / camp physical form
note: Form only.

name: Daycare / preschool / university admission form
note: Physical form only. Required immunization-status documentation may be insured.

name: Pre-employment / fitness-club form
note: Form only.

name: Hospital / nursing-home employee form
note: Form only.

name: Detailed fitness-to-work / accommodation report
note: For a detailed capabilities or restrictions report, rather than a brief note.

name: EI sickness benefits certificate — INS5140
note: Certificate only.

name: EI compassionate care benefits certificate
note: Certificate only.

name: Driver’s medical examination form
note: Form only; does not include an uninsured examination. Disability-related transportation benefit forms are handled separately below.

name: Civil aviation medical report — 26-0010E
note: Report only; the examination is separate.

name: Disability Tax Credit certificate — T2201
note: Report completion; the calculator applies the OMA suggested minimum.

name: CAS prospective foster-parent application
note: Prospective-parent application. CAS forms completed on behalf of a child are excluded from patient billing.

name: Attending Physician’s Statement — APS
note: Includes typical life, disability, short-term and long-term disability insurer statements.

name: Disease-specific / system-specific insurance questionnaire
note: Questionnaire only.

name: System-specific insurance examination
note: Uninsured examination requested by an insurer.

name: Insurance medical examination
note: Time for the examination and report.

name: Insurance clarification report
note: Prorated to the time entered.

name: Full narrative insurance report
note: For an insurer’s narrative report; CPP reports have separate payer arrangements.

name: Independent medical examination
note: Agree the examination and reporting scope with the requester.

name: Travel cancellation insurance form
note: Form only.

name: Life insurance death certificate
note: Insurer’s certificate; not the provincial medical certificate of death.

name: OCF-3 — Disability Certificate
note: Form only; agree payment with the insurer.

name: OCF-18 — Treatment and Assessment Plan
note: Form only; agree payment with the insurer.

name: OCF-19 — Determination of Catastrophic Impairment
note: Application form only; excludes the assessments required to establish impairment.

name: OCF-23 — Treatment Confirmation
note: Form only; agree payment with the insurer.

name: Travel consultation / counselling
note: Solely for travel outside Canada. Vaccine or drug cost is separate.

name: Travel-only vaccine administration
note: No preset OMA amount here. Do not use for insured vaccine administration; vaccine cost is separate.

name: Employment-only TB test and report
note: For pre-employment or periodic employer requirements. Medical indications, required education placements and LTC admission follow insured rules.

name: Financial incapacity certification and assessment
note: Only for appropriately qualified capacity assessors; confirm the applicable requirements.

name: Other uninsured assessment / procedure
note: Enter the current fee for the actual service. Use only after confirming it is uninsured.

name: Missed appointment / late cancellation
note: No preset OMA amount. Applies to missed visits or cancellations under 24 hours, with an advance policy and a cancellation system; consider reasonable exceptions.

name: Other uninsured work — hourly
note: Agree scope and rate in advance. Do not use to bypass medical-record copying rules.
